{{Top}}
The '''Minister of Education''' was an individual responsible for their government's education system.

The position existed in the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]], who was answerable to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]].

In more local examples, [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Antilles Organa]] held this position on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

[[Sindra Lintikoor]] was the Minister of Education for the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Sindra Lintikoor|Rori}}</ref>
